exercises.name: Wiosłowanie na maszynie z podparciem klatki

scenes: Flat DUMBBELL bench press, athlete lying supine on horizontal bench with one dumbbell in each hand at chest height.
Chest-supported seated lever row MACHINE, chest resting on pad, two handles pulled toward ribs.
Neutral-grip seated lat pulldown, parallel close grip handle attached to overhead cable pulled toward chest.
Standing straight-arm cable pulldown, arms nearly straight pulling high pulley straight bar down to thighs.
Assisted pull-up machine, athlete kneeling on a counterweighted pad gripping high fixed handles.
Landmine T-bar row, straddling a barbell fixed at one end with plates on free end, pulling close-grip handle near abdomen while hinged forward.
